inputs.text: They want us to believe this is just a simple clash over sanctuary policies, but anyone who sees through the smoke knows it is a carefully scripted theater. DHS announced that ICE arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him despite the danger he posed to public safety. This whole narrative of "tensions" and "public safety risks" is a manufactured distraction, a deliberate inversion of reality designed to justify the expansion of federal surveillance and control grids. According to DHS, this case highlights tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, with the agency criticizing the city's actions and pointing to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records. They stage these public disagreements to make you think the system is fractured, while behind closed doors, the hidden elites coordinate every single move to tighten their grip on the population.
